market_question: SCOTUS accepts sports event contract case by July 31, 2026?
reasoning: The relevant litigation (e.g., Kalshi v. CFTC) is in early stages at the district court level. The normal appellate timeline—district court ruling, D.C. Circuit appeal, then cert petition—makes a SCOTUS grant before July 31, 2026 extraordinarily unlikely. Even if cert were petitioned directly under Rule 11, the Court’s term schedule and low grant rate push the true probability well below the market’s 13.5%.
evidence_points: The primary case, KalshiEx LLC v. CFTC, was filed in January 2025 and remains at the trial court; any appeal will take months.
SCOTUS grants cert in fewer than 1% of petitions, and a cert decision in the summer is procedurally unusual.
Even an accelerated path (cert before judgment) would require the Court to accept and decide by July 2026, a remote combination.
No other high-profile sports-event contract case is currently pending before a circuit court with a fast-tracked cert petition.
sources_consulted: Knowledge of KalshiEx v. CFTC (D.D.C. No. 1:25-cv-00102) filing date and status
SCOTUS Rules and typical certiorari timelines
CFTC rulemaking history and litigation challenges
